[BEDWARS]
[!] Killaura now floors the hitreg cadence and swing animation at the weapon's own click limit, so Sync with a 0 swing time can no longer outrun the game
[+] InfiniteJump Velocity mode has Max jumps: 2 is a double jump, the counter refills on landing, and holding spacebar no longer adds a jump
[!] Speed CFrame mode no longer clips into walls while falling - each step is narrowed to what fits before the wall before it is applied
[!] Fixed ChatSpammer doing nothing
[!] Fixed every *Extender module: hooks install late and stay installed, kit reads fall back to the replicated attributes, and boosts land after the game's own movement
[+] Added 12 kit modules: AutoAngel, AutoBlackMarket, AutoBlockKicker, AutoCat, AutoDinoTamer, AutoFalconer, AutoGunBlade, AutoHatter, AutoMerchant, AutoRaven, AutoSorcerer and AutoVulcan
[^] CheatDetector rewritten with fixed, ping-independent thresholds: Speed 21 studs/sec with speed kits exempt, Reach 15 studs, Killaura angle rules, Fly over the void for a second, and a new AntiDeaths vertical-teleport check
[^] CheatDetector per-check toggles now gate their check

[GENERAL]
[^] Version 3.12.0
